_meta.basis: 7 nights, 2 adults, 1 room, USD, total for the stay, excluding local VAT where Booking says so.
_meta.source_type: Booking.com dated search and property pages, read 2026-11-25. This is an online travel agency, not the hotel's own booking engine. Every price row links to the exact dated query that produced it.
rules: Bed type and bathroom are copied from the room description on the page that quoted the price.
A price that only appears after signing in is labelled members-only and is never used as the planning number.
Taxes are shown exactly as the page showed them: included or excluded, never merged silently.
District is the area label Booking prints on the result card, not an inference.

hotels.name: Hilton Beijing Wangfujing
hotels.bathroom: Private bathroom (per the room description on the booking page)
hotels.w1_note: 15-22 Feb 2027, 7 nights, 2 adults, 1 king bed. Free cancellation, no prepayment needed.
hotels.w2_note: 1-8 Mar 2027: USD 1,101 plus USD 183 taxes and fees, Deluxe King-size room, free cancellation, no prepayment.
hotels.w2_comparable: Not strictly like-for-like: the February row is 'Deluxe King Room Plus', the March row is the standard Deluxe King. Both are one king bed.

hotels.name: Waldorf Astoria Beijing
hotels.w1_note: 15-22 Feb 2027, 7 nights, 2 adults, 1 king bed. No cancellation policy text captured for this row - treat as unconfirmed.
hotels.flag: The result card carried a 'Featured - pays us a higher commission' label. Ranking must not be read as value for money for this property.

hotels.name: New World Beijing Hotel
hotels.distance_to_center: 1.6 miles from downtown (Booking); 10-minute walk to Chongwenmen station (Lines 2 and 5), per Booking's property description
hotels.subway: Chongwenmen Subway Station, Lines 2 and 5, around 10 minutes on foot
hotels.bathroom: Private bathroom with walk-in shower and deep soaking bathtub
hotels.w1_note: 15-22 Feb 2027 public rate: USD 1,177. A members-only rate of USD 901 was displayed when signed in and is excluded from this figure.
hotels.w2_note: 1-8 Mar 2027 original public total: USD 1,257 before taxes, excluding 6% VAT; included 10% service charge. With an early-booker deal plus a Genius sign-in discount the page showed USD 961.23, which requires an account.
hotels.w2_comparable: Like-for-like: both rows are Superior Room King, 1 king bed, private bathroom.
hotels.flag: This is the one hotel where the same room type was priced in both windows: February is CHEAPER than the March week on the public rate (1,177 vs 1,257). Do not repeat the assumption that moving the trip later saves money.

hotels.name: Sunworld Dynasty Hotel Beijing Wangfujing
hotels.w1_note: 15-22 Feb 2027: USD 697 shown; the card's original price was USD 836 and the 697 figure was labelled a members-only price. Free cancellation. TWIN BEDS - fails the queen-or-bigger requirement as priced.
hotels.flag: Cheapest 5-star seen for the preferred week, but only as a twin. A queen/king room in the same hotel was not priced in this pass.

hotels.name: The Peninsula Beijing
hotels.flag: Appeared in the 15-22 Feb 5-star result set and is bookable, but its room price was not captured in the chunk that was read. Left blank rather than guessed. Highest guest score of the five.

hotels.name: Grand Hyatt Beijing
hotels.room: Apartment, 1 King Bed (48 m2, private bathroom with bath and shower, city view)
hotels.bathroom: Private bathroom with bath, shower and hairdryer (per the room description)
hotels.w1_note: The property page showed USD 1,568 for the 1 King Bed apartment on a non-refundable, pay-online rate, plus USD 260 taxes and fees. A refundable rate in the same room was not cleanly captured, so this figure is recorded as a note, not as the ranking price.
hotels.flag: The property page loaded in Portuguese. The 1,568 figure is a non-refundable apartment rate plus 260 in taxes; it is NOT comparable to the refundable room-only totals used for the other hotels, so it is excluded from the ranking.
